subject.title: cron: startup catch-up deferral lost on a second restart before it fires (silent missed run)

question: Which linked implementation should become the canonical fix path for this issue?
rationale: Two open PRs close this issue but propose different durable-marker storage boundaries, and the repository policy favors SQLite-owned runtime state over JSON sidecars.

options.title: Repair and land PR 102292
options.body: Keep the state-backed marker approach, require cron read/schema sanitation, and land that narrower fix once the compatibility finding is resolved.

options.title: Rework PR 102874
options.body: Accept that PR only if its JSON sidecar is replaced with SQLite-owned persistence or a maintainer explicitly approves the sidecar boundary.

options.title: Request storage-owner replacement
options.body: Close or pause both contributor branches and ask for a storage-owner implementation if maintainers want a dedicated internal SQLite column or migration shape.

recommendation.title: Repair and land PR 102292
recommendation.body: Keep the state-backed marker approach, require cron read/schema sanitation, and land that narrower fix once the compatibility finding is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current state-owned deferral marker path that the durable fix needs to extend or replace.
